verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party integration guides for specific coding agents or agent frameworks. It documents OpenAI API compatibility (swap the key, base URL and model ID), which only lets users wire the provider in themselves. A community remark mentions 'official support' for Cursor, but no documented guide backs it up, and a third-party router integration was reported to fail with a format error.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug the provider into coding agents and agent frameworks through documented, first-party integration guides
